name: Always Needing You
source:
What if just an action could change your entire life, but all you want is for things to be the same. 

All that Katie has ever wanted is the perfect life she has with her girlfriend Alex. However, since Emma’s troubled arrival, she’s been struggling to keep her life as it was. Their hatred for Emma seems to grow every day, but it’s impossible to allow her to leave. Among all this chaos, Katie still finds peace in making her O’Teros Cookies. She also prays for O’Tero God’s guidance.. 

[From [url=https://strangberryflakes.itch.io/always-needing-you]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
假如一個舉動就能改變你整個人生，而你只希望一切維持原樣呢？

Katie一直想要的，只有與女友Alex如今這般完美的生活。然而，自從麻煩纏身的Emma到來，她便不得不竭力維持原來的日子。她們對Emma的厭惡似乎與日俱增，卻又不可能放她離開。在這場混亂中，Katie仍能從製作O'Teros餅乾中獲得平靜，也向O'Tero神祈求指引。

[摘自[url=https://strangberryflakes.itch.io/always-needing-you]itch.io[/url]]
